card: Adds feature_dbcrash_replay.py, a deterministic functional test for Chainstate::ReplayBlocks that runs in base CI in roughly one second. Block replay recovery was previously only tested by feature_dbcrash.py, which relies on randomized crash points, takes several minutes, and is excluded from PR CI. The author demonstrates that this test deterministically catches off-by-one bugs in both the rollback and roll-forward loops in validation.cpp. There are no dependencies.
changed_since_previous: The core test logic remains the same, with minor adjustments or a rebase.
evidence: PR description demonstrates that the ~1-second test deterministically kills two off-by-one mutants in Chainstate::ReplayBlocks in src/validation.cpp: one in the rollback loop (while (pindexOld != pindexFork)) and one in the roll-forward loop (for (int nHeight = nForkHeight + 1; nHeight <= pindexNew->nHeight; ++nHeight)).
feature_dbcrash.py is in EXTENDED_SCRIPTS and therefore excluded from regular PR CI runs.
problem: Chainstate::ReplayBlocks is only tested by feature_dbcrash.py, which relies on randomized crash points, takes several minutes to run, and is placed in EXTENDED_SCRIPTS, meaning it never runs in PR CI. Off-by-one errors and regressions in crash recovery and block replay loops can easily pass CI undetected.

risk.why: This is a test-only change; any defect would only cause functional test failures in CI.

summary: Adds feature_dbcrash_replay.py to standard functional test runs to test Chainstate::ReplayBlocks deterministically. The test forces an immediate crash during a coins cache flush following a chain reorg, crashes a second time during ReplayBlocks flush, and verifies that a clean restart successfully rolls back the old branch and rolls forward to the tip.
